scripts.build:worker: here="$PWD" && cd "${GPROXY_EDGE_CRATE:-../../crates/gproxy-host-edge}" && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=none worker-build --release && node "$here/../../scripts/strip-wasm-debug.mjs" build/index_bg.wasm && rm -rf "$here/build" && cp -R build "$here/build"
scripts.build:assets: pnpm --dir ../../console build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R ../../console/dist public/console && node ../../console/scripts/prepare-edge-fonts.mjs public/console && cp public/console/index.html public/index.html && cp public/console/robots.txt public/robots.txt && cp _headers public/_headers
scripts.build: pnpm run build:worker && pnpm run build:assets
